## Exporting profiles over OTLP

Run the `profiling` receiver in a Collector pipeline with the
[otlpexporter](https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector/tree/main/exporter/otlpexporter),
see [local.example.yaml](../cmd/otelcol-ebpf-profiler/local.example.yaml).

When embedding the profiler in Go, pass the exporter to `reporter.NewCollector`:

```go
factory := otlpexporter.NewFactory().(xexporter.Factory)
cfg := factory.CreateDefaultConfig().(*otlpexporter.Config)
cfg.ClientConfig.Endpoint = "localhost:4317"

exp, err := factory.CreateProfiles(ctx, settings, cfg)
// handle err
err = exp.Start(ctx, host)
// handle err
rep, err := reporter.NewCollector(&reporter.Config{ReportInterval: 5 * time.Second}, exp)
```
